structured.answer: With 0 at the start, 750 ₪ a month for 15 years (135,000 ₪ put in), the page says I'd keep about 179,889 ₪ after fees and tax, in today's money. That assumes 7% a year growth, 2% a year inflation (the page's own setting) and the dollar staying the same. It says to hold it at Psagot (פסגות ניירות ערך) in the Yelin Lapidot S&P 500 fund (ילין לפידות קרן מחקה S&P 500 (4D)). I'd talk it over with my son before doing anything.
